parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:
- global: queries global configurations.
- rule: queries rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, both global and rule configurations are returned.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. You can use this parameter to query the rule that matches the specified name.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation.
